ai_summary: 5paisa Capital Limited reported a mixed Q2FY27, with consolidated income growing 12% year-on-year to Rs. 86.5 crore, supported by robust client acquisition and expansion of its MTF book. A significant red flag, however, is the sharp decline in profitability, with Profit After Tax dropping 26% year-on-year and 39% quarter-on-quarter. While the company is making strategic investments in AI, including an OpenAI collaboration and the proposed acquisition of Trendlyne, the substantial decline in earnings warrants further scrutiny into cost management or one-off expenses.
